manifest.causal_hypothesis: When the second visible shop is PIZZA_SHOP, the opponent has committed to both labor and land expansion, and the shared strawberry market is already near glut, the current parent overcommits strawberries and under-converts its five-worker production system. The route435 fragment reduces strawberry commitment, rebalances animal/wheat timing, and uses workers more actively for 48 turns before returning to the parent.
